pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is all about speaking! We will strike up a conversation (you can choose a topic ahead of time or we can see where the class takes us), during which I will monitor for common areas of improvement. We will discuss those notes during natural pauses in the conversation. 

I will provide only as much correction as you are comfortable with, so let me know if you need me to adjust. 

I can also provide suggestions for practice outside of class if you are interested, but the main focus  for class will be stress-free speaking, so let's get started!

*Please note, if I have back-to-back classes, I will begin to conclude class within the final 5-10 minutes to ensure a timely schedule. Thank you for your understanding.

pro_course_detail.title: English Your Way! (Reading? Music? Movies?)
pro_course_detail.description:
The best way to learn any language is to use materials you're interested in. In this class, we focus on your interests. Like reading fantasy novels? Let's read one together! Are you a music lover? Let's learn some lyrics! I've been known to improve my own vocabulary by translating recipes and knitting patterns. 

Whatever theme you love, we'll use it to improve all areas of language learning: listening, reading, speaking and writing. 

Homework will not be assigned unless requested, but I will give you tips on fun ways to continue your language practice outside of class. 

*Please note, if I have back-to-back classes, I will begin to conclude class within the final 5-10 minutes to ensure a timely schedule. Thank you for your understanding.
